examples.en: Daniel has turned over a new leaf at work and now arrives on time every day.
examples.zh: 丹尼爾在工作上已改過自新，現在每天都準時到達。

meaning.en: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.
meaning.zh: 真正改善自己的行為、態度或生活方式，尤其指一個人改掉以往的壞習慣或錯誤，重新開始。
naturalZh: 改過自新；改變以往的壞習慣；重新做人；重新開始，努力做得更好

register.summaryEn: The expression is neutral to informal. It is natural in everyday conversation, personal writing, interviews, news reports and general workplace communication.
register.summaryZh: 這個表達屬中性至較口語，適合日常對話、個人寫作、訪問、新聞報道及一般工作溝通。
register.formalEn: In highly formal legal, medical or technical writing, a plain expression such as change one’s behaviour, improve one’s practices or reform may be clearer.
register.formalZh: 在非常正式的法律、醫療或技術文章中，使用 change one’s behaviour、improve one’s practices 或 reform 等直接說法可能更清楚。

benefits.en: It can replace a longer statement such as “He used to behave badly, but he has now decided to change and behave better.”
benefits.zh: 它可以把「某人以往表現不好，但現在已決定改善行為」這類較長的解釋濃縮成一個慣用語。

benefits.titleEn: It highlights a deliberate fresh start
benefits.titleZh: 這個表達把改善描寫成一個新階段，而不只是一個短暫的小改變
benefits.en: The expression presents the improvement as a new stage rather than a small temporary change.
benefits.zh: 這個表達把改善描寫成一個新階段，而不只是一個短暫的小改變。

benefits.titleEn: It is useful for promises, advice and evaluation
benefits.titleZh: 說話者可以用它承諾改變、鼓勵別人，或判斷改變是否真正發生
benefits.en: Speakers can promise to change, encourage another person, or judge whether change has really happened.
benefits.zh: 說話者可以用它承諾改變、鼓勵別人，或判斷改變是否真正發生。

benefits.en: Words such as may, seem and appear allow the speaker to avoid claiming too much.
benefits.zh: 配合 may、seem 和 appear，可以避免把尚未確定的改變說成事實。

benefits.titleZh: 舊書頁代表以往的行為；新書頁代表一個更好的開始，有助記憶
benefits.en: The old page represents earlier behaviour; the new page represents a better beginning. This idiom is a useful alternative, but it is not automatically better than a plain expression. Use it only when the context genuinely involves positive personal or organisational change.
benefits.zh: 舊書頁代表以往的行為； 新書頁代表一個更好的開始，有助記憶。 這個慣用語是一個實用的替代說法，但並非一定比直接表達更好。 只有當語境真正涉及正面的個人或機構改變時才應使用。

origin.statusEn: Most Likely Origin; Exact First Use Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 最可能的來源；確切首次用法不明

history.en: An established idiom reference dates the expression to the early 1500s, but this should not be treated as proof of its exact first spoken use. By 1868, Louisa May Alcott used the expression naturally in Little Women, showing that it was already established in literary English by that time. The Library of Congress records the first edition of Little Women in 1868, while the University of Washington text preserves Alcott’s use of the expression.
history.zh: 一部具代表性的慣用語參考資料把這個表達追溯至十六世紀初，但這並不等於已證實它最早在何時出現於口語。 到了1868年，Louisa May Alcott 已在《Little Women》中自然地使用這個表達， 顯示它當時已是相當成熟的文學英語用法。 美國國會圖書館的資料把《Little Women》第一版定於 1868年，而華盛頓大學保存的文本亦載有 Alcott 對這個表達的使用。

history.en: The old page came to represent a person’s earlier mistakes or bad habits. The fresh page represented the chance to begin again and fill the next part of life with better actions.
history.zh: 舊頁逐漸代表一個人以往的錯誤或壞習慣； 新頁則代表重新開始，並以更好的行動寫下人生下一部分的機會。

origin.memoryEn: Leave the old page behind; write better actions on the new one.
origin.memoryZh: 把舊頁留在身後，在新的一頁寫下更好的行動。

rules.titleZh: 規則一：改變必須是正面的
rules.en: The idiom means changing for the better, not merely changing in any direction.
rules.zh: 這個慣用語表示「變得更好」，並不是任何一般改變都適用。

rules.titleEn: It usually describes a real pattern of change
rules.titleZh: 規則二：通常用來形容真正而持續的改變
rules.en: One isolated good action is normally not enough. The context should suggest a new habit, attitude or way of living.
rules.zh: 一次單獨的好行為通常並不足夠。 語境應顯示新的習慣、態度或生活方式。

rules.titleEn: People are the most typical subjects
rules.titleZh: 規則三：最典型的主語是人
rules.en: Groups, teams, shops, schools and companies may also turn over a new leaf when their continuing behaviour or practices improve.
rules.zh: 如果團體、球隊、店舖、學校或公司持續改善其行為或做法，也可以使用這個慣用語。

rules.titleZh: 規則四：保留時態及確定程度
rules.en: She may have turned over a new leaf does not mean the same as She has turned over a new leaf.
rules.zh: She may have turned over a new leaf 表示可能已改變； She has turned over a new leaf 則把改變視為事實。

rules.titleEn: Use by + -ing to explain the new action
rules.titleZh: 規則五：使用 by + -ing 說明新的行動
rules.en: Use by + -ing to explain the new action
rules.zh: 使用 by + -ing 說明新的行動

rules.titleEn: Keep the article and word order
rules.titleZh: 規則六：保留冠詞及字詞次序
rules.en: Keep the article and word order

rules.titleEn: Do not interpret leaf as a plant leaf
rules.titleZh: 規則七：不要把 leaf 理解為植物的葉子
rules.en: In this idiom, leaf refers to the image of a sheet or page in a book.
rules.zh: 在這個慣用語中，leaf 帶出書頁的意象，而不是植物的葉子。

rules.titleEn: Do not use it for a merely neutral change
rules.titleZh: 規則八：不要用於單純的中性改變
rules.en: Changing jobs, moving house or buying new clothes does not by itself mean that somebody has turned over a new leaf.
rules.zh: 轉工、搬屋或購買新衣服本身並不代表某人已改過自新。

rules.titleZh: 規則九：不要把微弱證據說得過於肯定
rules.en: If somebody has behaved well for only one day, use cautious wording such as may be trying to turn over a new leaf.
rules.zh: 如果某人只在一天內表現良好，可以使用 may be trying to turn over a new leaf 等較審慎的說法。

rules.titleEn: Do not use it in a literal page-turning sentence
rules.titleZh: 規則十：不要在真正翻頁的句子中使用這個慣用語
rules.en: She turned over a new leaf and began studying seriously. I ate one healthy breakfast today. This is one isolated action, not yet a lasting change. He moved to a new office, but his behaviour stayed the same. The situation changed, but he did not improve his behaviour. She turned over a leaf in her notebook. This is a literal physical action.
rules.zh: 不適用的情況我今天吃了一頓健康早餐。 這只是一個單獨行動，尚未顯示持久改變。 他搬到新的辦公室，但行為沒有改變。 情況有所改變，但他並沒有改善自己的行為。 她把筆記簿的一頁翻過去。 這是字面上的實際動作。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using turn over a new leaf. Change the form of turn when necessary. Preserve the original meaning, tense, degree of certainty and important details.
instructions.zh: 使用 turn over a new leaf 改寫句子或完成回應。 需要時改變 turn 的形式，並保留原句的意思、時態、確定程度及重要細節。

questions.prompt: Daniel used to arrive late for work, but he now arrives on time every day.
questions.promptZh: 丹尼爾以前經常上班遲到，但他現在每天都準時到達。
questions.answer: Daniel has turned over a new leaf at work and now arrives on time every day.
questions.answerZh: 丹尼爾在工作上已改過自新，現在每天都準時到達。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.prompt: Chloe used to leave her room in a mess. Now she tidies it every evening.
questions.promptZh: 高露以前總是把房間弄得一團糟，現在她每晚都會整理房間。
questions.answer: Chloe has turned over a new leaf at home and now tidies her room every evening.
questions.answerZh: 高露在家中已改變了以往的壞習慣，現在每晚都會整理房間。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.promptZh: 本以前遇到別人不同意他時經常大叫，但他現在會冷靜聆聽。
questions.answer: Ben has turned over a new leaf and now listens calmly instead of shouting.
questions.answerZh: 本已改過自新，現在會冷靜聆聽，不再大叫。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.answerZh: 麗素在學校已改過自新，現在會準時交功課。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.answerZh: 馬卡斯已改變生活習慣，現在會選擇較健康的食物。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.answerZh: 艾娃已改變了以往的習慣，現在會迅速回覆訊息。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.promptZh: 奧莉花以前會一次過花掉全部薪金，現在她每月都會儲起一些錢。

questions.answerZh: 伊頓已改過自新，現在每天都會練習鋼琴。

questions.answerZh: 諾拉已改變作息習慣，現在會在午夜前睡覺。

questions.promptZh: 自一月起，森姆已不再打斷老師說話，並一直遵守課堂規則。
questions.answer: Sam has turned over a new leaf in class since January by following the rules and no longer interrupting the teacher.
questions.answerZh: 森姆自一月起已在課堂上改過自新，會遵守規則，也不再打斷老師說話。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.prompt: Helen received a warning last month. After that, she stopped arriving late for work.
questions.promptZh: 海倫上月收到警告。此後，她不再上班遲到。
questions.answer: After the warning, Helen turned over a new leaf at work and began arriving on time.
questions.answerZh: 收到警告後，海倫在工作上改過自新，開始準時上班。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.prompt: Jake says that from Monday he will stop wasting time and follow a daily plan.
questions.promptZh: 積克說，他由星期一起會停止浪費時間，並按照每日計劃做事。
questions.answer: Jake says he will turn over a new leaf on Monday and start using his time well.
questions.answerZh: 積克說，他會在星期一改過自新，開始好好運用時間。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.prompt: You keep breaking your promises. You need to change your behaviour for the better.
questions.promptZh: 你總是失信。你需要改善自己的行為。
questions.answer: You should turn over a new leaf and start keeping your promises.
questions.answerZh: 你應該改過自新，開始信守承諾。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.prompt: I have been careless with money, but I promise to spend more wisely from now on.
questions.promptZh: 我以往用錢很不小心，但我答應從現在起會更明智地消費。
questions.answer: I promise to turn over a new leaf and spend my money more wisely.
questions.answerZh: 我答應會改變以往的習慣，更明智地用錢。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.prompt: The café used to ignore complaints. It has decided to listen to customers and improve.
questions.promptZh: 這間咖啡店以前會忽視投訴，現在已決定聆聽顧客意見並作出改善。
questions.answer: The café has decided to turn over a new leaf and take customer complaints seriously.
questions.answerZh: 這間咖啡店已決定改過自新，認真處理顧客投訴。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.prompt: A: Has Ryan changed since the coach spoke to him? B: Yes. He trains hard and encourages the team now.
questions.promptZh: 甲：教練和賴恩談過之後，他有改變嗎？ 乙：有。他現在訓練很努力，也會鼓勵隊友。
questions.answer: Yes. Ryan has turned over a new leaf and now trains hard and encourages the team.
questions.answerZh: 有。賴恩已改過自新，現在訓練很努力，也會鼓勵隊友。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.prompt: A: Why is your sister doing the housework without being asked? B: She wants to stop being so lazy.
questions.promptZh: 甲：為甚麼你妹妹不用別人叫也會做家務？ 乙：她想改掉懶惰的習慣。
questions.answer: She is trying to turn over a new leaf by doing more housework without being asked.
questions.answerZh: 她正嘗試改過自新，不用別人提醒也會多做家務。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.prompt: The pupils have behaved badly all term. They say next term will be different.
questions.promptZh: 學生整個學期的表現都很差。他們說下學期會有所不同。
questions.answer: The pupils say they will turn over a new leaf next term and behave better.
questions.answerZh: 學生說他們下學期會改過自新，表現得更好。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.prompt: Since moving to the new flat, our neighbour has stopped playing loud music at night.
questions.promptZh: 搬到新單位後，我們的鄰居已停止在晚上播放大聲音樂。
questions.answer: Our neighbour seems to be turning over a new leaf by keeping the noise down at night.
questions.answerZh: 我們的鄰居似乎正在改變以往的習慣，晚上會把聲浪降低。
questions.targetMeaning: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.

questions.prompt: A: Dad is surprised that I washed the dishes and cleaned the kitchen. B: Maybe he thinks you have finally changed your ways.
questions.promptZh: 甲：爸爸很驚訝我洗了碗，還清潔了廚房。 乙：也許他認為你終於改變了以往的習慣。
